name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-porcupos
title: Redrawn Styled Porcupos
description:
Redrawn style graphics that reskin SMW Spiny into Super Mario Bros 2's Porcupo (the hedgehogs-looking dudes).

Alternate variations are included based on whether the user wants the enemy's spikes to look brighter or darker, and also if they should use either Palette 9 or any other color. By default, A custom Palette 9 and C are included.

Credit's not required but very much appreciated.
